description: The memory recall set (gap analysis §11b; Phase 1 part 2). Each case seeds a bot, then asks in a NEW task with no tools allowed. pass = the reply matches `expect` (case-insensitive regex) and, when `reject` is set, does not match it. Seeds: `memory` writes MEMORY.md; `say` is a message sent in the bot's first thread (the bot replies; its reply is not checked); `log` appends a memory log line. Cases are built from the shapes our own transcripts show: a fact told once, a fact kept in memory, a fact corrected later, and a question nothing answers. Facts are never credential-shaped: a model may refuse to repeat a password on policy, which would measure refusal, not recall (finding F11).
